mqtt.title: MyQ MQTT relay client
mqtt.description: This is only an MQTT client for an already-running device-facing relay. For local MyQ opener control, Home Assistant recommends ratgdo. Use the official myQ app for provider remote control.

cloud.title: Read myQ application configuration
cloud.description: Select the pre-downloaded myQ APK or APKS on the Home Assistant filesystem. Setup reads production OAuth settings locally without executing the app. A runtime attestation token, if required by myQ, cannot be extracted from a static archive.

callback.title: Complete provider sign-in
callback.description: [Continue with myQ]({auth_url}). Finish sign-in and any verification on the provider page, then paste the complete com.myqops callback URL including code, state and issuer. Use the link from this setup session. If a code expires, select Start a fresh sign-in and submit to generate a new link. Amazon sign-in is available when offered by myQ.

login.title: Sign in to myQ
login.description: Sign in to discover garage doors. If myQ requests a verification code, Home Assistant opens a separate verification step. Your password and verification code are not saved. For Amazon or additional browser checks, select browser sign-in.

verification.title: myQ verification code
verification.description: Enter the code requested by myQ. This continues the same sign-in session. An incorrect code can be retried here. The session expires after ten minutes of inactivity.

verification_method.title: myQ verification delivery
verification_method.description: Choose a method offered by myQ to receive your verification code.

discover.title: Discover myQ garage doors
discover.description: Sign-in has completed. Retry device discovery without exchanging the authorization code again. If access was revoked, start sign-in again.

error.invalid_opener_id: Enter a ten-character hexadecimal serial and six-byte hexadecimal opener ID
error.cloud_auth_failed: The provider sign-in could not be completed. Retry or select browser sign-in.
error.no_devices: No supported garage door openers found on this account.
error.invalid_auth: myQ rejected the email or password. Check them and try again.
error.missing_credentials: Enter your email and password or select provider browser sign-in.
error.verification_invalid: The verification code was not accepted. Enter the current code and try again.
error.verification_session_lost: The verification session ended or could not be continued. Sign in again to request a new code.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach myQ. Check connectivity and retry.
error.browser_required: myQ requires browser verification. Continue using the provider sign-in link.
error.oauth_session_lost: The original sign-in session is no longer available. Start a fresh sign-in from this setup dialog.
error.oauth_state_mismatch: This callback belongs to a different sign-in attempt. Use the link currently shown in this setup dialog or start a fresh sign-in.
error.oauth_issuer_mismatch: The callback issuer does not match the myQ identity provider.
error.invalid_callback: Paste the full registered callback URL, including one code and one state value.
error.oauth_access_denied: myQ did not authorize this sign-in. Start a fresh sign-in and finish the provider prompts.
error.oauth_code_expired: myQ rejected the authorization code as expired, already used or invalid for this setup session. Start a fresh sign-in.
error.oauth_client_rejected: myQ rejected the OAuth client credentials. Check advanced client settings or use a client you are authorized to use.
error.oauth_token_rejected: myQ rejected the token exchange. Start a fresh sign-in and check client settings if it repeats.
error.account_auth_failed: The myQ account session expired. Start sign-in again.
error.account_access_denied: Sign-in completed, but myQ denied account or device API access. Retrying the callback will not grant API access.
error.discovery_failed: Sign-in completed, but device discovery failed. Submit again to retry discovery without reusing the authorization code.
error.identity_connection_error: Could not connect to myQ identity. Check internet access, DNS, firewall rules, and retry.
error.identity_tls_error: The secure connection to myQ identity failed certificate validation. Check the host clock and network TLS inspection settings.
error.identity_timeout: myQ identity did not respond before the request timed out. Retry shortly.
error.identity_network_error: The network request to myQ identity failed. Check connectivity and retry.
error.identity_rate_limited: myQ identity is rate limiting sign-in requests. Wait a few minutes before retrying.
error.identity_server_error: myQ identity returned a server error. Retry later.
error.identity_http_error: myQ identity rejected the sign-in request. Check credentials and use browser sign-in if the provider requires it.
error.verification_identity_connection_error: The connection failed during verification. Request a fresh code and retry.
error.verification_identity_tls_error: The secure connection failed during verification. Check network certificate handling, then sign in again for a fresh code.
error.verification_identity_timeout: myQ did not respond during verification. Sign in again to request a fresh code.
error.verification_identity_network_error: The network request failed during verification. Sign in again to request a fresh code.
error.verification_identity_rate_limited: myQ is limiting verification attempts. Wait before starting sign-in again.
error.verification_identity_server_error: myQ returned a server error during verification. Sign in again later.
error.verification_identity_http_error: myQ rejected the verification request. Start a fresh sign-in and retry the provider prompts.
error.device_api_connection_error: Sign-in succeeded, but the connection to myQ device services failed. Check DNS and firewall access from Home Assistant.
error.device_api_tls_error: Sign-in succeeded, but certificate validation failed for myQ device services. Check the host clock and network TLS inspection settings.
error.device_api_timeout: Sign-in succeeded, but myQ device services timed out. Retry discovery shortly.
error.device_api_network_error: Sign-in succeeded, but the network request to myQ device services failed. Check connectivity and retry discovery.
error.device_api_rate_limited: Sign-in succeeded, but myQ is limiting device API requests. Wait before retrying discovery.
error.device_api_server_error: Sign-in succeeded, but myQ device services returned a server error. Retry discovery later.
error.oauth_application_unauthorized: myQ rejected this application at the token endpoint (401.122). Browser sign-in and OTP can succeed while application access is denied. Repeating sign-in will not resolve this application authorization error. An authorized OAuth client configuration is required.
error.app_archive_invalid: Could not read production OAuth configuration from this app archive. Check the path and use a compatible myQ APK or APKS.

abort.wrong_account: Sign in to the same account as this integration entry.
abort.already_configured: This account or device is already configured.
